=== 59142 - Staff May 6 2026 Memo re PGRR 145.pdf ===
                   Public Utility Commission of Texas

                                    Memorandum

TO:           Chairman Thomas J. Gleeson
              Commissioner Kathleen Jackson
              Commissioner Courtney K. Hjaltman
              Commissioner Morgan Johnson
              Commissioner Patrick Rhode

FROM:         Barksdale English, Deputy Executive Director

DATE:         May 6, 2026
RE:           May 7, 2026 Open Meeting – Agenda Item No. 30
              Project No. 59142 – Review of ERCOT’s Interconnection Processes for Large
              Loads

As early as tomorrow, ERCOT stakeholders will take the first of several planned votes on ERCOT
rule changes to implement the Batch Study transmission planning process, including Planning
Guide Revision Request (PGRR) 145. Commission Staff recommends the Commission consider
three adjustments to the Batch 0 entry criteria drafted in PGRR 145 to address industry concerns
about using contract for power supply as evidence of project maturity.

Several stakeholders have indicated that using contracts for power supply as indicated in
Commission Staff’s April 12, 2026 memo and further reflected in PGRR 145 would set a
premature and unworkable threshold for projects envisioned to fit within the “Advancing
Maturity” project category of base loads.

On the next page is the table originally presented to you during the April 17, 2026 open meeting,
revised to reflect the guidance you provided during that meeting. The table is further revised in
redline to highlight this current set of recommendations addressing the contract for power supply
concern raised by stakeholders.

We look forward to discussing these recommendations with you tomorrow.
